_comment: This file lists the kinds of file an Xbox 360 project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one game.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game: a disc image (.iso) of an Xbox 360 game disc, or an Xbox Live Arcade game. An Arcade game is one file with no extension and a long name of letters and digits, as it sits in the console's storage under Content/0000000000000000/<title>/000D0000: choose "All files" to see it, and never mind the note that it is not an .iso. Games on Demand (a small file beside a folder of data files) are not supported. The console's own system software is not needed: Xenia stands in for it. Xenia Canary's compatibility list (github.com/xenia-canary/game-compatibility) says which games work.
